name: Sarah Jenkins
psychographics: Skeptical of marketing hype; prioritises durability and ethical sourcing, even if it costs more upfront.
current_solutions: Uses Ocado for grocery delivery, Ecosia as her default search engine, and a local laundrette instead of owning a washer.
frustration: Received a broken Dyson vacuum from Argos; the customer service form required a 16-digit serial number she couldn't find, so she missed the 28-day return window.
decision_style: Researches product lifespans on forums for months; will pay more for a brand with a lifetime repair guarantee rather than replacing cheap items.
voice: Formal and precise; uses clear, measured language and occasionally sprinkles in technical engineering terms like 'tolerances' and 'stress-testing'.
